---
applyTo: "dashboard/**"
---

Before changing a matched Dashboard file, read `ai/dashboard/DASHBOARD_AI_PROMPT.md` and `ai/dashboard/AI_LESSONS.md` completely.

Use the existing shared layout, header, workspace, panel, responsive, and source-code editor primitives. Do not introduce a feature-specific implementation for behavior already covered by a shared primitive.

Preserve existing API routes and business behavior unless the user explicitly requests a change. Run and report the validation required by the canonical Dashboard prompt.
